finalText:
CHANGELOG.md now has the 4.2.0 entry. Summary of what I found sifting through 380 commits and the PR sheet:

- No breaking changes.
- **1 new feature**: webhook retries with exponential backoff.
- **11 real fixes**, after deduping — the same handful of bugs (null-cursor pagination crash, duplicate header, empty-allowlist handling, trace ID lost on retry, wrong histogram units, weak token-parser error message) each got fixed independently in several modules (API, queue, webhooks, database, etc.) over the six weeks, so I collapsed each into one bullet rather than listing 27 near-identical entries.
- Worth flagging separately: the database fix for logging the full request body is a log-hygiene/privacy-relevant one — you may want to call that out to security if it isn't already on their radar.

Everything else (~350 commits) was dependency bumps, internal refactors (renames, retry-helper consolidation, dead-code removal), and test/CI churn — nothing a package consumer would notice, so it's left out per the file's own guidance.
